newsitem.title: USA: Wisconsin 485 MW nuke seen on line Weds.
newsitem.headline: Wisconsin 485 MW nuke seen on line Weds.

text.p: Wisconsin Electric Power Co's 485 megawatt (MW) Point Beach nuclear power unit 1 should resume power production on Wednesday following a repair outage, a company spokeswoman said Monday.
"We are planning to restart the unit on Tuesday, and it should be back on line on Wednesday," Wisconsin Electric spokeswoman Jackie Olson said.
The unit, located in Two Rivers, Wis., was shut Feb 18 to repair a cooling system pump. Startup of the unit was delayed from original expectations for repairs to an emergency diesel generator.
The adjacent Point Beach nuclear unit 2, also with a capacity of 485 MW, was expected to return to service near April 12 following a refueling outage that began in October, 1996.
Wisconsin Electric is a subsidiary of Wisconsin Energy Corp.
